resolved: “Directly assert that the bidding start and end times remain unchanged after cancelling the withdrawal dialog” — remember + expect_remembered compare a value across elements, screens or portals (as numbers with as/delta); expect_api_value compares with the API

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ with Vendor A's bid, as required for this case.
Enable eRFX projects required for the RFQ event.
Keep counter offers available on RFQ stages as required by the case configuration.
Use the required buyer bid-action configuration while bidding is open.
Apply the required buyer bid-edit configuration.
Apply the required counter-offer percentage configuration.
Open the RFQ stage before accessing its responses and settings.
Open the RFQ Responses tab where the existing bid can be verified.
Verify the event is live before attempting withdrawal cancellation.
Record that the live RFQ still has exactly one direct vendor response.
Verify the existing response still belongs to the prepared vendor.
Verify the existing bid price is displayed before the withdrawal attempt.
Open the RFQ withdrawal flow without confirming the withdrawal.
Verify the withdrawing-order window opened.
Cancel the withdrawal so the event should remain unchanged.
Verify the withdrawing-order window closed after cancellation.
Verify the event remains live after cancelling withdrawal.
Verify the same single direct vendor response remains after cancellation.
Verify the vendor on the response is unchanged.
Verify the vendor bid remains unchanged.
